CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.agent_darkstar_merge(p_task_id text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v agent_subtasks%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
  SELECT * INTO v
  FROM agent_subtasks
  WHERE parent_task_id = p_task_id
    AND role = 'verify'
    AND status = 'DONE'
    AND result_status = 'accepted'
  ORDER BY updated_at DESC
  LIMIT 1;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('merged', false, 'reason', 'verify not accepted');
  END IF;
  UPDATE agent_tasks
  SET status = 'COMPLETED', progress = 'merged', progress_note = v.result, updated_at = now(), last_activity_at = now()
  WHERE task_id = p_task_id;
  INSERT INTO collab_events (task_id, event_type, actor_id, payload)
  VALUES (p_task_id, 'TASK_STATUS', 'darkstar', jsonb_build_object('status', 'COMPLETED', 'verify_id', v.subtask_id));
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('merged', true, 'task_id', p_task_id, 'verify_id', v.subtask_id, 'result', v.result);
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.agent_darkstar_tick()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  expired jsonb;
  n integer;
BEGIN
  expired := agent_expire_leases();

  UPDATE agent_subtasks v
  SET status = 'READY',
      updated_at = now()
  WHERE v.role = 'verify'
    AND v.status = 'DRAFT'
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM agent_subtasks e
      WHERE e.parent_task_id = v.parent_task_id
        AND e.role = 'extract'
        AND e.status = 'DONE'
        AND e.result_status = 'accepted'
    );
  GET DIAGNOSTICS n = ROW_COUNT;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object('expire', expired, 'verify_ready', n);
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.agent_expire_leases()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  n integer;
  m integer;
BEGIN
  UPDATE agent_subtasks
  SET status = 'READY',
      claimed_by = NULL,
      assigned_agent = NULL,
      lease_until = NULL,
      result_status = 'expired',
      result = NULL,
      updated_at = now()
  WHERE status = 'CLAIMED'
    AND lease_until IS NOT NULL
    AND lease_until < now()
    AND COALESCE(result_status, '') <> 'accepted';
  GET DIAGNOSTICS n = ROW_COUNT;

  UPDATE agent_registry
  SET status = 'OFFLINE',
      connection_status = 'not_connected',
      lease_until = NULL,
      current_task_id = NULL,
      updated_at = now()
  WHERE role IN ('extract', 'verify')
    AND status = 'WORKING'
    AND (last_heartbeat IS NULL OR last_heartbeat < now() - interval '45 seconds');
  GET DIAGNOSTICS m = ROW_COUNT;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object('released', n, 'workers_offline', m);
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.aivault_compute_claim_task(p_node_id uuid, p_lease_token uuid, p_lease_seconds integer DEFAULT 30)
 RETURNS aivault_compute_tasks
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_task public.aivault_compute_tasks;
begin

  /*
   * Only healthy nodes may receive work.
   */
  if not exists (
    select 1
    from public.aivault_compute_nodes n
    where n.id = p_node_id
      and n.status = 'online'
      and n.paused_by_user = false
      and coalesce(n.battery_level, 100) > 10
      and n.thermal_state in ('unknown', 'nominal', 'fair')
  ) then
    return null;
  end if;

  /*
   * Atomic queue claim.
   *
   * FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED prevents multiple nodes
   * from claiming the same task concurrently.
   */
  with next_task as (
    select id
    from public.aivault_compute_tasks
    where status = 'queued'
      and attempt_count < max_attempts
    order by priority asc, created_at asc
    for update skip locked
    limit 1
  )
  update public.aivault_compute_tasks t
  set
    status = 'leased',
    assigned_node_id = p_node_id,
    lease_token = p_lease_token,
    lease_started_at = now(),
    lease_expires_at = now() + make_interval(
      secs => greatest(5, least(p_lease_seconds, 120))
    ),
    claimed_at = now(),
    attempt_count = t.attempt_count + 1,
    updated_at = now()
  from next_task
  where t.id = next_task.id
  returning t.*
  into v_task;

  if v_task.id is null then
    return null;
  end if;

  /*
   * Node becomes busy.
   */
  update public.aivault_compute_nodes
  set
    status = 'busy',
    last_task_started_at = now(),
    updated_at = now()
  where id = p_node_id;

  return v_task;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.aivault_compute_mark_offline_nodes(p_timeout_seconds integer DEFAULT 60)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_count integer;
begin

  update public.aivault_compute_nodes
  set
    status = 'offline',
    updated_at = now()
  where status in ('online', 'busy')
    and last_heartbeat_at < now() - make_interval(
      secs => greatest(30, least(p_timeout_seconds, 600))
    );

  get diagnostics v_count = row_count;

  /*
   * Their active leases become eligible for recovery.
   */
  update public.aivault_compute_tasks
  set
    status = 'queued',
    assigned_node_id = null,
    lease_token = null,
    lease_started_at = null,
    lease_expires_at = null,
    last_error = 'node_offline',
    updated_at = now()
  where status in ('leased', 'running')
    and assigned_node_id in (
      select id
      from public.aivault_compute_nodes
      where status = 'offline'
    );

  return v_count;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.aivault_compute_requeue_expired_tasks()
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_count integer;
begin

  update public.aivault_compute_tasks
  set
    status = case
      when attempt_count >= max_attempts then 'failed'
      else 'queued'
    end,
    assigned_node_id = null,
    lease_token = null,
    lease_started_at = null,
    lease_expires_at = null,
    last_error = 'lease_expired',
    updated_at = now()
  where status in ('leased', 'running')
    and lease_expires_at is not null
    and lease_expires_at < now();

  get diagnostics v_count = row_count;

  /*
   * Any busy node whose task disappeared gets released.
   */
  update public.aivault_compute_nodes n
  set
    status = case
      when n.paused_by_user then 'paused'
      else 'online'
    end,
    updated_at = now()
  where n.status = 'busy'
    and not exists (
      select 1
      from public.aivault_compute_tasks t
      where t.assigned_node_id = n.id
        and t.status in ('leased', 'running')
        and t.lease_expires_at > now()
    );

  return v_count;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.check_ai_security_guard_health()
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
    guard_record record;
    latest_heartbeat timestamptz;
    elapsed_seconds integer;
    new_status text;
begin

    for guard_record in
        select id
        from public.ai_security_guards
        where is_active = true
    loop

        -- 找到這個 Guard 最新的 heartbeat
        select h.recorded_at
        into latest_heartbeat
        from public.ai_security_heartbeats h
        where h.guard_id = guard_record.id
        order by h.recorded_at desc
        limit 1;

        -- 尚未有 heartbeat
        if latest_heartbeat is null then

            new_status := 'offline';
            elapsed_seconds := null;

        else

            elapsed_seconds :=
                greatest(
                    0,
                    floor(
                        extract(
                            epoch from (now() - latest_heartbeat)
                        )
                    )::integer
                );

            if elapsed_seconds <= 30 then
                new_status := 'healthy';

            elsif elapsed_seconds <= 60 then
                new_status := 'warning';

            elsif elapsed_seconds <= 120 then
                new_status := 'critical';

            else
                new_status := 'offline';

            end if;

        end if;


        -- 建立或更新 Health 狀態
        insert into public.ai_security_guard_health (
            guard_id,
            health_status,
            last_heartbeat_at,
            seconds_since_heartbeat,
            consecutive_failures,
            takeover_required,
            last_checked_at
        )
        values (
            guard_record.id,
            new_status,
            latest_heartbeat,
            elapsed_seconds,
            case
                when new_status in ('critical', 'offline')
                then 1
                else 0
            end,
            case
                when new_status = 'offline'
                then true
                else false
            end,
            now()
        )
        on conflict (guard_id)
        do update set
            health_status = excluded.health_status,
            last_heartbeat_at = excluded.last_heartbeat_at,
            seconds_since_heartbeat = excluded.seconds_since_heartbeat,
            consecutive_failures =
                case
                    when excluded.health_status in ('critical', 'offline')
                    then public.ai_security_guard_health.consecutive_failures + 1
                    else 0
                end,
            takeover_required =
                case
                    when excluded.health_status = 'offline'
                    then true
                    else false
                end,
            last_checked_at = now(),
            updated_at = now();

    end loop;

end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.dark_star_search_ebook_pages(terms text[], book_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, result_limit integer DEFAULT 6)
 RETURNS TABLE(page_id uuid, ebook_id uuid, book_title text, page_number integer, chapter text, section text, excerpt text, score integer)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  with keywords as (
    select distinct lower(left(trim(t),80)) term
    from unnest(terms[1:24]) t where length(trim(t)) between 2 and 80
  ), ranked as (
    select p.id, p.ebook_id, b.title book_title, p.page_number, p.chapter, p.section,
      p.content, sum(case when strpos(lower(p.content),k.term)>0 then length(k.term) else 0 end
        + case when strpos(lower(coalesce(p.title,'')||' '||coalesce(p.chapter,'')||' '||coalesce(p.section,'')),k.term)>0 then 3 else 0 end)::integer score,
      min(nullif(strpos(lower(p.content),k.term),0)) first_match
    from public.dark_star_ebook_pages p join public.dark_star_ebooks b on b.id=p.ebook_id
    cross join keywords k
    where (book_id is null or p.ebook_id=book_id) and coalesce(p.content,'')<>''
    group by p.id,p.ebook_id,b.title,p.page_number,p.chapter,p.section,p.content
  )
  select id,ebook_id,book_title,page_number,chapter,section,
    substring(content from greatest(1,coalesce(first_match,1)-600) for 5000),score
  from ranked where score>0 order by score desc,ebook_id,page_number
  limit greatest(1,least(coalesce(result_limit,6),10));
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.darkstar_normalize_compute_capability(p_platform text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_gpu jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb, p_capability jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb, p_accelerator jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb, p_memory_gb numeric DEFAULT NULL::numeric)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
  with src as (
    select lower(
      coalesce(p_platform,'') || ' ' ||
      coalesce(p_gpu::text,'') || ' ' ||
      coalesce(p_capability::text,'') || ' ' ||
      coalesce(p_accelerator::text,'')
    ) as s
  )
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'platform_family',
      case
        when s like '%iphone%' or s like '%ios%' then 'apple_mobile'
        when s like '%mac%' or s like '%macos%' or s like '%apple silicon%' or s like '%apple%' then 'apple_silicon'
        when s like '%nvidia%' or s like '%cuda%' or s like '%rtx%' or s like '%h100%' or s like '%h200%' or s like '%b200%' then 'nvidia'
        when s like '%amd%' or s like '%rocm%' or s like '%radeon%' then 'amd'
        else 'unknown'
      end,
    'accelerators',
      to_jsonb(array_remove(ARRAY[
        case when s like '%neural engine%' or s like '%neural_engine%' or s like '%npu%' then 'neural_engine'::text end,
        case when s like '%cuda%' or s like '%tensor core%' or s like '%tensor_core%' then 'cuda_tensor'::text end,
        case when s like '%metal%' or s like '%mlx%' or s like '%apple silicon%' or s like '%macos%' then 'metal_mlx'::text end,
        case when s like '%rocm%' then 'rocm'::text end,
        case when s like '%webgpu%' then 'webgpu'::text end
      ], null)),
    'memory_gb', coalesce(p_memory_gb, nullif(regexp_replace(
      coalesce(p_gpu->>'memory_gb', p_capability->>'memory_gb', p_capability->>'device_memory_gb',''),
      '[^0-9.]','','g'
    ), '')::numeric),
    'ai_role',
      case
        when s like '%neural engine%' or s like '%neural_engine%' or s like '%npu%' then 'ai_accelerator'
        when s like '%tensor core%' or s like '%cuda%' then 'gpu_ai_accelerator'
        when s like '%webgpu%' then 'browser_gpu'
        else 'general_compute'
      end,
    'recognition_version', 'darkstar-compute-capability-v1'
  )
  from src;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.darkstar_rank_compute_nodes(p_task_profile jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb)
 RETURNS TABLE(node_id text, score numeric, platform_family text, accelerators jsonb, memory_gb numeric, ai_role text, reasons jsonb)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
  with nodes as (
    select
      n.node_id, n.gpu, n.capability, n.available, n.status, n.last_seen,
      public.darkstar_normalize_compute_capability(
        n.platform,n.gpu,n.capability,n.accelerator,n.memory_gb
      ) as cap
    from public.compute_mesh_nodes n
    where coalesce(n.available,false) = true
      and n.status in ('READY','AVAILABLE','IDLE','ONLINE')
  )
  select
    node_id,
    round((
      case when coalesce((cap->>'memory_gb')::numeric,0) >= coalesce((p_task_profile->>'min_memory_gb')::numeric,0)
           then 40 else 0 end
      + case
          when lower(coalesce(p_task_profile->>'preferred_accelerator','')) = 'neural_engine'
               and cap->'accelerators' ? 'neural_engine' then 30
          when lower(coalesce(p_task_profile->>'preferred_accelerator','')) = 'cuda_tensor'
               and cap->'accelerators' ? 'cuda_tensor' then 30
          when lower(coalesce(p_task_profile->>'preferred_accelerator','')) = 'metal_mlx'
               and cap->'accelerators' ? 'metal_mlx' then 30
          when lower(coalesce(p_task_profile->>'preferred_accelerator','')) = '' then 10
          else 0
        end
      + case
          when lower(coalesce(p_task_profile->>'task_family','')) in ('llm','reasoning','coding')
               and cap->>'ai_role' in ('ai_accelerator','gpu_ai_accelerator') then 20
          when lower(coalesce(p_task_profile->>'task_family','')) in ('vision','image')
               and cap->'accelerators' ? 'webgpu' then 15
          else 0
        end
      + case when last_seen is not null and last_seen > now() - interval '2 minutes' then 10 else 0 end
    )::numeric,2) as score,
    cap->>'platform_family',
    cap->'accelerators',
    nullif(cap->>'memory_gb','')::numeric,
    cap->>'ai_role',
    jsonb_build_object(
      'task_family', p_task_profile->>'task_family',
      'preferred_accelerator', p_task_profile->>'preferred_accelerator',
      'memory_ok', coalesce((cap->>'memory_gb')::numeric,0) >= coalesce((p_task_profile->>'min_memory_gb')::numeric,0)
    )
  from nodes
  order by score desc, node_id;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_current_ai_duty()
 RETURNS TABLE(employee_code text, display_name text, nationality text, job_title text, shift_code text, shift_name text, location_code text, room_name text, work_status text, duty_date date, taipei_time timestamp without time zone)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
    select
        e.employee_code,
        e.display_name,
        e.nationality,
        e.job_title,

        s.shift_code,
        s.shift_name,

        l.location_code,
        l.room_name,

        coalesce(
            ws.status,
            'idle'
        ) as work_status,

        a.shift_date,

        now() at time zone 'Asia/Taipei'

    from public.ai_employee_shift_assignments a

    join public.ai_employees e
        on e.id = a.employee_id

    join public.ai_shift_templates s
        on s.id = a.shift_template_id

    left join public.ai_employee_locations el
        on el.employee_id = e.id
        and el.is_primary = true

    left join public.virtual_office_locations l
        on l.id = el.location_id

    left join lateral (
        select status
        from public.ai_employee_work_sessions ws
        where
            ws.employee_id = e.id
            and ws.ended_at is null
        order by ws.started_at desc
        limit 1
    ) ws
        on true

    where
        a.shift_date =
            (now() at time zone 'Asia/Taipei')::date

        and a.assignment_status in (
            'scheduled',
            'working'
        )

        and (
            (
                s.crosses_midnight = false
                and localtime >= s.start_time
                and localtime < s.end_time
            )

            or

            (
                s.crosses_midnight = true
                and (
                    localtime >= s.start_time
                    or localtime < s.end_time
                )
            )
        )

    order by e.employee_code;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_current_shift()
 RETURNS TABLE(shift_code text, shift_name text, start_time time without time zone, end_time time without time zone, timezone text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
    select
        s.shift_code,
        s.shift_name,
        s.start_time,
        s.end_time,
        s.timezone
    from public.ai_shift_templates s
    where
        (

            and localtime >= s.start_time

        )
        or
        (
            s.crosses_midnight = true
            and (
                localtime >= s.start_time
                or localtime < s.end_time
            )
        )
    limit 1;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.start_new_governance_topic(p_workspace_id uuid, p_owner_id uuid, p_title text, p_description text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS governance_topics
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_topic public.governance_topics;
BEGIN

    -- 關閉同一 Workspace / Owner 目前仍開啟的議題
    UPDATE public.governance_topics
    SET
        status = 'closed',
        locked = false,
        completed_at = COALESCE(completed_at, now()),
        updated_at = now()
    WHERE workspace_id = p_workspace_id
      AND owner_id = p_owner_id
      AND status IN ('active', 'open', 'in_progress');

    -- 建立新的目前議題
    INSERT INTO public.governance_topics (
        topic_id,
        workspace_id,
        owner_id,
        title,
        description,
        status,
        locked,
        parent_topic_id,
        created_at,
        updated_at,
        completed_at
    )
    VALUES (
        gen_random_uuid()::text,
        p_workspace_id,
        p_owner_id,
        p_title,
        p_description,
        'active',
        false,
        NULL,
        now(),
        now(),
        NULL
    )
    RETURNING * INTO v_topic;

    RETURN v_topic;

END;
$function$
